t: Lesson 11 — Step 9: the displays, the preset and Enter
html:
In the app

Guided mode’s lesson 11 is this chapter: it checks that this lesson’s tags are made, that S9_Count exists, is called from MainRoutine and verifies, and then watches the line while you run it and ticks each result as it happens:

  • The LARGE display counts a large bottle
  • The SMALL display counts a small bottle

Four counts and a batch stop. Add the JSR and write:

Tags this lesson needs

Create these before you type the rungs (Verify reports any you miss as unknown). Tags from earlier lessons are not repeated.

The rungs

How it fits together

The four ADD rungs count once per event with a one-shot: the scrap gate firing, the divert gate firing (small bottles), a large unbroken bottle being capped (Cap_Req with LS7, Large 9, not Broken 8, after the shift), and a box filling (Box_Full). The displays on the panel show those tags, and the simulator’s counters read them too. Rung 4 is the batch preset: a number dialled on the thumbwheel greater than zero, and the large count reaching it, sets Batch_Done, which step 1’s seal-in breaks on; rung 5 clears all four counts on Enter, which also clears Batch_Done so Start works again.

Run it

Dial 0020 on the thumbwheel and press Start. The line stops itself when the LARGE display reaches 20, and the Run lamp goes out. Press Enter: the counts zero. Press Start: it runs again.

Try it

Count large bottles at the end of the line (LS11) instead of at the capper, and compare the two counts over a batch.

rungs.head: S9_Count · Rung 0
rungs.comment: SCRAP DISPLAY: count once each time the scrap gate fires
rungs.words: When Scrap_Gate (LogixPro O:2/4 · Scrap gate: swings a bottle into the grinder) is on and this is the first scan of it, the rung makes Scrap_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/2 · Scrap bottle count, shown on the SCRAP display) = Scrap_Bottle_Count + 1.
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Scrap_Gate) Examine If Closed asks: true when Scrap_Gate is on.
  2. ONS(Scrap_ONS) One Shot asks: true on the first scan its input is true (remembered in Scrap_ONS). It passes power for one scan only, the scan its input goes from false to true; its storage bit remembers last scan.
  3. ADD(Scrap_Bottle_Count,1,Scrap_Bottle_Count) Add does: makes Scrap_Bottle_Count = Scrap_Bottle_Count + 1. Every scan the rung is true; behind a one-shot it adds once per event.

pats.t: One-shot: once per event, not once per scan.
pats.why: The rung after the one-shot is true for exactly one scan each time its conditions become true, so what follows happens once per event rather than every 20 ms while the condition lasts.
pats.think: a turnstile. However long you stand in it, it counts you once.
pats.watch: Each one-shot needs its own storage bit. Two one-shots sharing a bit fight over it, and one of them never fires.

rungs.head: S9_Count · Rung 1
rungs.comment: SMALL DISPLAY: count once each time the divert gate fires (it only fires for small bottles)
rungs.words: When Divert_Gate (LogixPro O:2/5 · Divert gate: swings a bottle onto the divert conveyor) is on and this is the first scan of it, the rung makes Small_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/1 · Small bottle count, shown on the SMALL display) = Small_Bottle_Count + 1.
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Divert_Gate) Examine If Closed asks: true when Divert_Gate is on.
  2. ONS(Divert_ONS) One Shot asks: true on the first scan its input is true (remembered in Divert_ONS). It passes power for one scan only, the scan its input goes from false to true; its storage bit remembers last scan.

pats.t: One-shot: once per event, not once per scan.
pats.why: The rung after the one-shot is true for exactly one scan each time its conditions become true, so what follows happens once per event rather than every 20 ms while the condition lasts.

rungs.head: S9_Count · Rung 2
rungs.comment: LARGE DISPLAY: a large, unbroken bottle gets capped (ram at the bottom, Large bit 9 / Broken bit 8 after the shift): one count
rungs.words: When Cap_Req (A bottle stands under the cap ram and has not been capped) is on, LS7 (LogixPro I:1/12 · Cap ram down) is on, Large[0].9 (Large bottle (LogixPro B3:20). During the dwell: filler 5, capper 8, scrap gate 12, divert gate 19; after the shift one bit higher) is on, Broken[0].8 (Broken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher) is off and this is the first scan of it, the rung makes Large_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/0 · Large bottle count, shown on the LARGE display) = Large_Bottle_Count + 1.
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Cap_Req) Examine If Closed asks: true when Cap_Req is on.
  2. XIC(LS7) Examine If Closed asks: true when LS7 is on.
  3. XIC(Large[0].9) Examine If Closed asks: true when Large[0].9 is on.
  4. XIO(Broken[0].8) Examine If Open asks: true when Broken[0].8 is off.
  5. ONS(Large_ONS) One Shot asks: true on the first scan its input is true (remembered in Large_ONS). It passes power for one scan only, the scan its input goes from false to true; its storage bit remembers last scan.
  6. ADD(Large_Bottle_Count,1,Large_Bottle_Count) Add does: makes Large_Bottle_Count = Large_Bottle_Count + 1. Every scan the rung is true; behind a one-shot it adds once per event.

pats.t: One-shot: once per event, not once per scan.
pats.why: The rung after the one-shot is true for exactly one scan each time its conditions become true, so what follows happens once per event rather than every 20 ms while the condition lasts.

rungs.head: S9_Count · Rung 3
rungs.comment: BOXES DISPLAY: one count each time a box fills
rungs.words: When Box_Full (Grinder BoxFull: the box under the scrap drop holds its share) is on and this is the first scan of it, the rung makes Scrap_Box_Count (LogixPro O:4/3 · Scrap box count, shown on the BOXES display) = Scrap_Box_Count + 1.
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Box_Full) Examine If Closed asks: true when Box_Full is on.
  2. ONS(Box_ONS) One Shot asks: true on the first scan its input is true (remembered in Box_ONS). It passes power for one scan only, the scan its input goes from false to true; its storage bit remembers last scan.
  3. ADD(Scrap_Box_Count,1,Scrap_Box_Count) Add does: makes Scrap_Box_Count = Scrap_Box_Count + 1. Every scan the rung is true; behind a one-shot it adds once per event.

pats.t: One-shot: once per event, not once per scan.
pats.why: The rung after the one-shot is true for exactly one scan each time its conditions become true, so what follows happens once per event rather than every 20 ms while the condition lasts.

rungs.head: S9_Count · Rung 4
rungs.comment: BATCH PRESET: dial a number on the thumbwheel and the line stops itself when that many large bottles have been capped (0 = no limit). Batch_Done breaks the seal-in in step 1

pred.q: Thumbwheel is 1 and Large_Bottle_Count is 21. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is true: Batch_Done is on.

rungs.words: When Thumbwheel (LogixPro I:3 · Thumbwheel switch, read as a number (BCD on the real one)) is greater than 0 and Large_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/0 · Large bottle count, shown on the LARGE display) is at least Thumbwheel, the rung turns Batch_Done (The large-bottle count has reached the thumbwheel preset) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. GRT(Thumbwheel,0) Greater Than asks: true when Thumbwheel is greater than 0.
  2. GEQ(Large_Bottle_Count,Thumbwheel) Greater Than or Equal asks: true when Large_Bottle_Count is at least Thumbwheel.
  3. OTE(Batch_Done) Output Energize does: turns Batch_Done on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

rungs.head: S9_Count · Rung 5
rungs.comment: ENTER on the thumbwheel clears all four counts, which also clears Batch_Done so the line can be started again
rungs.words: When Enter (Thumbwheel Enter button) is on and this is the first scan of it, the rung clears Large_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/0 · Large bottle count, shown on the LARGE display) to 0, clears Small_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/1 · Small bottle count, shown on the SMALL display) to 0, clears Scrap_Bottle_Count (LogixPro O:4/2 · Scrap bottle count, shown on the SCRAP display) to 0 and clears Scrap_Box_Count (LogixPro O:4/3 · Scrap box count, shown on the BOXES display) to 0.
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Enter) Examine If Closed asks: true when Enter is on.
  2. ONS(Enter_ONS) One Shot asks: true on the first scan its input is true (remembered in Enter_ONS). It passes power for one scan only, the scan its input goes from false to true; its storage bit remembers last scan.
  3. A branch of 4 parallel paths: each path is tested on its own and does its own work.
    Path 1
    1. CLR(Large_Bottle_Count) Clear does: clears Large_Bottle_Count to 0.
    Path 2
    1. CLR(Small_Bottle_Count) Clear does: clears Small_Bottle_Count to 0.
    Path 3
    1. CLR(Scrap_Bottle_Count) Clear does: clears Scrap_Bottle_Count to 0.
    Path 4
    1. CLR(Scrap_Box_Count) Clear does: clears Scrap_Box_Count to 0.

pats.t: One-shot: once per event, not once per scan.
pats.why: The rung after the one-shot is true for exactly one scan each time its conditions become true, so what follows happens once per event rather than every 20 ms while the condition lasts.
